items.title: Reforge — Mastering B2B Customer Discovery
items.description: In-depth training program on B2B discovery techniques. Covers stakeholder research, interview techniques, synthesis methods, and opportunity validation for enterprise products.

items.title: Product-Led Growth Certification
items.description: Comprehensive certification covering PLG fundamentals. Includes modules on freemium strategy, trial design, viral loops, and PQL scoring with B2B case studies.

items.title: B2B SaaS Pricing Certification
items.description: Structured program on value-based pricing, packaging strategy, and pricing experiments. Includes real B2B case studies from Dropbox, Figma, and Notion.

items.title: SVPG Product Masterclass
items.description: Marty Cagan and the SVPG team's intensive product management training. Covers product strategy, discovery, delivery, and team empowerment with strong B2B content.

items.title: Mind the Product — Product Leadership Program
items.description: Executive product management training for senior PMs and Heads of Product. Focus on product strategy, organizational design, and scaling B2B product organizations.

items.title: Intercom — Product-Led Growth Training
items.description: Free training on building PLG motions. Covers onboarding optimization, in-app messaging strategy, and conversion funnel analysis with hands-on exercises.
